fn_get_effective_branch_id.arguments: p_tenant_id text, p_record_type text, p_record_id text, p_raw_branch_id text
fn_get_effective_branch_id.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_get_effective_branch_id(p_tenant_id text, p_record_type text, p_record_id text, p_raw_branch_id text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT "newBranchId"
     FROM "BranchReconciliationAudit"
     WHERE "tenantId" = p_tenant_id
       AND "recordType" = p_record_type
       AND "recordId" = p_record_id
       AND "newBranchId" IS NOT NULL
     ORDER BY "createdAt" DESC, "id" DESC
     LIMIT 1),
    p_raw_branch_id
  );
$function$
